name: Codebattle
// updateRemoteUserUID: Must stay false: bin/dev always runs as the image uid 1000, and the _build/deps/node_modules/plts volumes are owned by it. Letting the editor remap the user to the host uid makes those volumes unwritable from the editor container.
postStartCommand: sh -c 'test -f /workspace/mix.exs || { echo "/workspace is not the codebattle repository root: this container was started with a Compose project directory other than the repository root, so the source bind mount resolved to the wrong host directory." >&2; exit 1; }'
